settings.language.label: Language
signin.scopes.title: What each sign-in shares with AgentMux
signin.scopes.google: Google: your name, email address and profile picture (the openid, email and profile permissions).
signin.scopes.apple: Apple: your name, if you choose to share it, and your email address, or a private relay address if you choose Hide My Email (the name and email permissions). While AgentMux Cloud is invitation-only, choose Share My Email.
signin.scopes.neither: Neither gives AgentMux access to your Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, iCloud or anything else in your account.
signin.panel.note: ⓘ Sign in to AgentMux Cloud in your browser — one account per install, no key to manage.
signin.panel.signInNoLongerWorks: ⓘ The sign-in for {{who}} no longer works. Sign in again to reconnect.
signin.github.needsCloud: GitHub tokens for your agents come from AgentMux Cloud, so this needs your AgentMux Cloud account.
agentPicker.filters.label: Filter the new-agent cards
agentPicker.filters.disabledHint: Close the open panel to change the filters.
agentPicker.filterBar.name: Name (A–Z)
agentPicker.empty.title: No definitions configured
agentPicker.empty.desc: Use the ⚙ Agent settings to add your first definition.
agentPicker.templates.hint: Each card is a harness (the CLI that runs the agent, e.g. Claude Code, Codex) — you'll pick which model it uses next.
agentPicker.templates.managedNote: AgentMux installs and runs its own copy of each agent CLI, kept apart from any you installed yourself (to run yours instead, switch on "Use the CLI on my PATH" for it in Toolchain), and keeps each agent's login and settings in its own folders. This isolates the tools, not what an agent can do on your computer.
agentPicker.notices.nodeHint: After installing, restart AgentMux and try again.
agentPicker.menu.label: Template actions
agentCard.updateTitle: A newer CLI version is pinned by AgentMux — update it in the Toolchain pane
agentCard.newSessionTitle: Archive current session and start a new one
agentCard.newSessionLabel: Start a new session for {{name}} (archives the current one)
agentCreate.duplicateName: You already have an agent named {{name}}. Choose another name.
agentCreate.hint: {{name}} is the harness, the CLI tool that runs this agent. Pick which model it uses below; the harness stays the same either way.
agentCreate.name.label: Name
agentCreate.name.note: Name it for its job, like Reviewer or Docs writer, so you can tell your agents apart.
agentCreate.runtime.label: Runtime
agentCreate.runtime.containerNoDocker: Container (runs in Docker) — Docker not detected
agentCreate.runtime.note: Container: runs in Docker, sandboxed. Native: runs on this computer with your files and tools.
agentCreate.runtime.nativeOnly: {{name}} can only run as a Native agent.
agentCreate.image.label: Container image
agentCreate.image.standardNote: The smallest image: the agent, git, GitHub CLI and Python.
agentCreate.image.developerNote: Adds Rust, a C toolchain, go-task and a headless display, so the agent can build and run projects (about 660 MB to download, on top of the standard image).
agentCreate.model.label: Model
agentCreate.model.note: Which model {{name}} runs with. Changeable later from the agent pane's runtime picker.
agentCreate.vendor.label: Model Vendor / Custom Endpoint
agentCreate.vendor.note: Redirect this agent's harness at a custom API endpoint (e.g. a proxy or alternate model backend) instead of the default vendor. Leave blank to use the default.
agentCreate.bundles.label: Bundles
agentCreate.bundles.note: In order: when two bundles name the same skill, the first wins.
freeGuide.title: Use {{name}} for free
access.checked.aging.one: checked {{count}} day ago, may have changed
access.checked.aging.other: checked {{count}} days ago, may have changed
access.local.worked: Works in AgentMux's own test with {{model}} ({{date}}).
access.local.failed: Did not work in AgentMux's own test with {{model}} ({{date}}).
access.local.untested: Documented by the CLI, not tested by AgentMux.
login.authorizeHint: Your browser should have opened automatically. If it didn't, copy this backup link and open it manually:
login.pasteHint: After you authorize, the page shows a code — paste it here:
containerImage.note.denied: The container image can't be downloaded: its registry refuses access. New agents run as Native agents (on this computer) until that is fixed.
containerImage.note.notFound: The container image wasn't found in its registry. New agents run as Native agents (on this computer) until that is fixed.
containerImage.developer.denied: The developer image can't be downloaded: its registry refuses access. Pick the standard image, or try again later.
containerImage.developer.notFound: The developer image isn't published for this version of AgentMux yet. Pick the standard image, or update AgentMux.
containerCaches.label: Build cache
containerCaches.size.one: {{size}} in {{count}} volume: what {{name}}'s builds keep (the cargo registry and build output), so a new container or an image update does not start from nothing.
containerCaches.size.other: {{size}} in {{count}} volumes: what {{name}}'s builds keep (the cargo registry and build output), so a new container or an image update does not start from nothing.
containerCaches.large: That is a lot of disk. Clearing it frees the space; the next build starts cold.
containerCaches.cleared: Cleared: {{size}} freed. The container starts again at the agent's next message.
agentEnv.intro: The extra environment variables {{name}} starts with.
agentEnv.label: Environment
agentEnv.hint: One per line, NAME=VALUE; # starts a comment. Applies at the agent's next launch. Names starting AGENTMUX_ are reserved.
agentEnv.saved: Saved. It applies at the agent's next launch.
agentEnv.reason.badName: {{key}} is not a name: use letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit
settings.appearance.theme.label: Theme
settings.appearance.theme.description: Default UI color theme, for windows without one of their own (the ☰ menu sets one window's)
settings.appearance.splash.label: Startup splash screen
settings.appearance.splash.description: Show the AgentMux splash while the app starts. Applies at the next launch — the launcher reads this before the app itself is running.
settings.appearance.transparency.label: Window transparency
settings.appearance.opacity.label: Opacity
settings.appearance.opacity.description: Default window opacity (35–100%), for windows without one of their own (the ☰ menu sets one window's)
settings.appearance.blur.label: Background blur
settings.appearance.blur.description: Blur the content behind the window
settings.appearance.paneGap.label: Pane gap size
settings.appearance.bgColor.label: Background color
settings.appearance.bgColor.description: Custom background color override (hex). Leave blank to use the theme default.
settings.appearance.magnifiedOpacity.des: Background opacity of a pane while magnified (0–1)
settings.appearance.magnifiedSize.label: Magnified size
settings.appearance.magnifiedSize.descri: Scale factor applied to a pane while magnified
settings.appearance.magnifiedBlurPrimary: Backdrop blur, in pixels, applied to the magnified pane itself
settings.appearance.magnifiedBlurSeconda: Backdrop blur, in pixels, applied to the other panes behind it
settings.appearance.widgetColors.label: Widget colors
settings.appearance.widgetColors.descrip: The color of every pane of each widget type: its border, tabs and header. A pane's own Pane Color and an agent's color still win.
settings.language.description: The language of AgentMux's own screens. It does not change what agents reply in, and text from a hosted agent's terminal or tools stays in its own language. A language marked Beta shows English for what is not translated yet.
settings.rail.label: Settings section
settings.animations.preset.label: Animations
settings.animations.preset.description: Turn animations off, or make them quicker, smoother or slower. Applies at once in every window.
settings.animations.speed.label: Animation duration (%)
settings.animations.speed.description: How long animations take, as a percent of their designed timing. 0 is off; lower is quicker.
settings.animations.polish.label: Hover and fade polish (%)
settings.animations.polish.description: The length of hover and focus fades and hover lifts, as a percent of their designed timing. 0 is off.
settings.animations.reduceMovement.label: Reduce movement
settings.animations.reduceMovement.descr: Replace slides, zooms and bounces with fades.
settings.window.showBlockIds.label: Show block IDs
settings.window.showBlockIds.description: Show each pane's internal block ID in its header (debugging aid)
settings.window.defaultNewBlock.label: Default new block
settings.window.defaultNewBlock.descript: View type opened by default for new tabs/panes (e.g. term, agent, shortcuts)
settings.window.showPaneNumberOverlay.de: Show numbered overlays for quick pane-jump shortcuts
settings.window.mouseSideButtons.label: Mouse side buttons select the previous / next pane
settings.window.mouseSideButtons.descrip: Back and Forward re-select the pane you had selected before or after, in any tab. Ctrl + button is page back / forward over a browser pane
settings.window.showStatusBar.label: Show the status bar
settings.window.showStatusBar.descriptio: The bar along the bottom with the backend dot, system stats, token and history totals, and the version. Hiding it frees a row of space; it comes back by itself if the backend goes down, and "Toggle Status Bar" in the command palette flips it
settings.window.confirmTabClose.label: Confirm before closing a tab
settings.window.confirmTabClose.descript: Ask before closing a tab, instead of closing it at once
settings.window.confirmCloseWorking.labe: Warn before closing a window with working agents
settings.window.confirmCloseWorking.desc: Ask before closing a window while an agent in it is mid-turn. Closing stops its agents; the window stays in the workspace, to reopen from the version panel
settings.browser.profiles.label: Browser profiles
settings.browser.profiles.description: Each profile keeps its own sign-ins, cookies and site data, so one site can be open as two accounts side by side. Open a tab in one from the Profile button in a browser pane. Personal is the one every tab started with; it can't be removed. An agent can browse as a profile only if you switch on "Agents may use it" for that profile; on Windows it can also use an Incognito tab.
settings.browser.searchSuggestions.label: Search suggestions while typing
settings.browser.searchSuggestions.descr: The address bar also asks your search engine for suggestions as you type, as Chrome does, which sends it what you type before you press Enter. Incognito tabs never ask, as in Chrome. Turn it off to keep suggestions to this computer (your history and the addresses you typed).
settings.browser.hibernate.label: Hibernate hidden browser panes
settings.browser.hibernate.description: A browser pane out of sight for a while goes to sleep: its page is put away to free its memory, often 100 to 200 MB, and loads again when you're about to look at it, with a note while it restores. It comes back with its back/forward history, scroll position and anything typed into it, on browser engines that support it; on older ones it loads fresh. Never a pane an agent is using, one playing or capturing media, one with something typed into it, or a local dev server.
settings.browser.hibernateAfter.label: Minutes hidden before it sleeps
settings.browser.hibernateAfter.descript: Sooner when the computer is low on memory: 5 minutes, then 1.
settings.browser.keepAwakeSites.label: Sites that never sleep
settings.browser.keepAwakeSites.descript: Browser panes on these sites stay awake however long they are hidden. A site covers its subdomains (example.com covers mail.example.com); write an address with https:// to keep just that one.
settings.browser.pauseAll.label: Pause all agent browsing
settings.browser.pauseAll.description: An emergency stop: while it is on, every browser pane an agent drives refuses every call the agent makes, and the clocks of auto-approve grants stand still. It stays on after a restart until you turn it off here, in the status bar or from the command palette.
settings.terminal.defaultShell.label: Default shell
settings.terminal.defaultShell.descripti: The shell new local terminals open with. Agents' shells and SSH or WSL terminals keep their own.
settings.terminal.fontSize.label: Font size
settings.terminal.fontFamily.label: Font family
settings.terminal.terminalTheme.label: Terminal color theme
settings.terminal.scrollback.label: Scrollback lines
settings.terminal.scrollback.description: Number of lines kept in terminal scrollback (1000–100000)
settings.terminal.copyOnSelect.label: Copy on select
settings.terminal.copyOnSelect.descripti: Automatically copy selected text to clipboard
settings.terminal.shiftEnterNewline.desc: In a terminal: Shift+Enter sends a newline instead of running the line
settings.terminal.durableSsh.label: Keep SSH sessions alive
settings.terminal.durableSsh.description: Durable SSH terminals keep their shell running on the host (in AgentMux's small helper there), so a dropped link, sleep or a restart reconnects instead of ending it. On a host without the helper, the first terminal asks before installing it, and is a plain terminal if it isn't installed. Connectors → Remotes can set it per host.
settings.terminal.helperInstall.label: Install the helper on new hosts
settings.terminal.helperInstall.descript: Durable terminals and file browsing on an SSH host need AgentMux's small helper there. Ask before installing it, install it without asking, or never install it. Each host can override this in Connectors → Remotes, and an agent's install is always asked about.
settings.terminal.bracketedPaste.label: Bracketed paste
settings.terminal.bracketedPaste.descrip: Allow programs to detect pasted text vs. typed text
settings.terminal.terminalTransparency.d: Terminal background transparency (0 = opaque, 1 = fully transparent)
settings.terminal.scrollSensitivity.desc: Scroll wheel speed multiplier for terminal panes (0.1–10, default 1). Independent of the OS scroll-speed setting.
settings.terminal.cpuMemBadge.label: Show CPU/mem badge
settings.terminal.cpuMemBadge.descriptio: Show a live CPU%/memory usage badge in the top-right corner of terminal panes
settings.terminal.predictiveEcho.label: Predictive echo
settings.terminal.predictiveEcho.descrip: Show local predictive echo of typed characters while waiting on a slow/remote shell
settings.terminal.predictiveEchoThreshol: Round-trip latency (ms) above which predictive echo kicks in
settings.terminal.agentMaxRuntime.label: Agent max runtime
settings.terminal.agentMaxRuntime.descri: Hours before the watchdog kills a long-running agent pane. 0 = no limit.
settings.terminal.agentIdleTimeout.label: Agent idle timeout
settings.terminal.agentIdleTimeout.descr: Minutes of PTY silence before the watchdog kills an idle agent pane. 0 = no limit.
settings.animations.help.system: Uses your computer's setting. Windows: Settings, Accessibility, Visual effects, Animation effects. macOS: Accessibility, Display, Reduce motion.
settings.animations.reducedNotice: Your system asks for reduced motion. AgentMux is not following it because you chose {{choice}}.
settings.animations.advancedHelp: The numbers below are what Follow system uses now (from your system). Choose another option to set your own.
settings.animations.snapped: {{raw}} is out of range: using {{next}}. Use 0, or {{min}} to {{max}} in steps of {{step}}.
settings.animations.preview.card: A card that slides and fades in
settings.animations.preview.panel: A panel that collapses and opens
settings.advanced.devMode.label: Dev mode
settings.advanced.devMode.description: Shows DevTools in the menu, Inspect Element and View Page Source in right-click menus, and other developer tools. Off by default in the installed app; on by default in a task dev or debug build
settings.advanced.disableWebgl.label: Disable WebGL rendering
settings.advanced.disableWebgl.descripti: Fall back to canvas-based terminal rendering (restart required)
settings.advanced.autoAnswerTimeout.desc: Seconds an AskUserQuestion panel waits for you before auto-selecting the recommended option(s)
settings.advanced.compactAt.label: Compact agents at
settings.advanced.compactAt.description: Thousands of tokens at which Claude agents compact their context. Lower saves tokens; higher keeps more detail. 0 keeps Claude Code's own (about 967). Takes effect when each agent next starts
settings.advanced.routeSpendCap.label: Model route daily cap
settings.advanced.routeSpendCap.descript: Dollars a day that all agents together may use through the OpenRouter model route. When it is used, every agent on the route stops until you raise it here or the UTC day ends. 0 is no cap
settings.advanced.previewSkidNotches.des: Wheel notches a tool preview absorbs at its top or bottom edge before the scroll passes to the pane, so a preview sliding under the pointer is not scrolled past. 0 passes it on at once. Applies to open panes
settings.advanced.containerMemory.label: Container agents' memory
settings.advanced.containerMemory.descri: Megabytes of memory each container agent may use, unless the agent has its own limit. auto is half of what Docker has (at least 2 GB). 0 is no limit. Reaches running containers without restarting them
settings.advanced.containerCpus.label: Container agents' CPUs
settings.advanced.containerCpus.descript: CPUs each container agent may use, unless the agent has its own limit. auto is all but a quarter of what Docker has (at least one). 0 is no limit. Reaches running containers without restarting them
settings.advanced.subagentModel.label: Sub-agent model
settings.advanced.subagentModel.descript: The model Claude agents' general-purpose sub-agents run on: sonnet, haiku, opus, a model ID, or inherit to use the agent's own. A sub-agent that names its own model, or one the agent passes per call, still wins. Takes effect when each agent next starts
settings.advanced.exploreModel.label: Explore sub-agent model
settings.advanced.exploreModel.descripti: The model Claude agents' Explore sub-agents run on: haiku, sonnet, opus, a model ID, or inherit to leave Claude Code's built-in. Takes effect when each agent next starts
settings.advanced.compactHints.label: Suggest compacting
settings.advanced.compactHints.descripti: When an agent's turn ends with a large context, tell it once that it can compact itself before its next task, so it doesn't compact by itself mid-task
settings.advanced.overlapNotes.label: Overlap notes
settings.advanced.overlapNotes.descripti: Tell an agent when it edits a file another agent on this computer is also changing, naming that agent so it can message them first
settings.advanced.retryOnReconnect.label: Retry after the API is back
settings.advanced.retryOnReconnect.descr: When a turn failed because the model API couldn't be reached, retry it once by itself when the API answers again, unless a tool ran in it or you typed in that pane since
settings.advanced.kanbanReminders.label: Remind idle agents of their backlog
settings.advanced.kanbanReminders.descri: An agent with tasks waiting in its Kanban backlog gets a note after 2 minutes idle, once each time it goes idle
settings.advanced.sampleInterval.label: Sample interval
settings.advanced.historyLength.label: History length
settings.advanced.historyLength.descript: Number of sysinfo widget samples retained (30–1024)
settings.advanced.enableFileDrop.label: Enable file drop
settings.advanced.enableFileDrop.descrip: Drag files onto an agent pane to attach them
settings.advanced.insertReferenceToken.d: Also insert a file-reference token into the composer on drop, in addition to attaching the file
settings.advanced.maxConcurrentUploads.d: Files uploaded at once on a multi-file drop. Leave blank for unlimited.
settings.advanced.globalEnvVars.label: Global environment variables
settings.advanced.globalEnvVars.descript: Environment variables injected into every shell
settings.browser.agentSites.label: Agents on sites
settings.browser.agentSites.description: What an agent may do on a site without asking each time, until you revoke it. Every row lets the agent make committing clicks there without asking (a payment still asks). Add Terminal to let it type and run commands in a web terminal there, such as Cloud Shell: nobody checks each line, so Stop, Pause and Take over in the pane are how you stop it, and Revoke here ends it at once. Tick "ask me for each line" instead to be shown every line in the pane, with Run it and Don't run, before it goes in. Enter and Space lets it press those keys, each taken as the click it is (a form's default button, a button, a link, a checkbox) and checked like any click. Uploads lets it fill the file chooser a page opens with files from its own workspace, and only those.
settings.browser.keepAwake.notASite: "{{site}}" isn't a site: write a host like example.com, or an address.
settings.browser.profile.deleteAsk: Delete {{name}}? It has {{signins}} in the Vault.
settings.browser.profile.agentsNote: Each agent browses as a profile of its own by default, so its sign-ins stay from one pane to the next. Deleting one signs that agent out everywhere; it gets a fresh one the next time it opens a browser.
settings.agents.agentView.label: What an agent pane shows
settings.agents.agentView.description: The default for every agent pane that has not chosen its own: Full shows everything, Standard folds thinking, tool calls and jekts to one line and hides setup, Replies shows the conversation only. Errors and anything waiting for you always show. A pane's View menu changes one pane.
settings.devices.cloudPresence.label: Cloud presence
settings.devices.cloudPresence.descripti: This computer tells the cloud it is online, so your signed-in devices can list it from anywhere.
settings.agents.desktopDriving.label: Let agents look at and control desktop apps
settings.agents.desktopDriving.descripti: Off by default. When on, an agent can see a window of a native app and click and type in it, but only after you allow that app for that agent, for a while or for its session. Web browsers, password managers and AgentMux itself are always refused, and you can stop an agent at any time. Every action is logged. Works on Windows for now.
settings.devices.pairedDevices.label: Paired devices
settings.devices.pairedDevices.descripti: Devices paired with this computer can watch its agents over your local network. Turn on Can send to let one send messages to your agents as you. Revoke one to stop it.
settings.devices.shareTerminals.label: Share terminals with paired devices
settings.devices.shareTerminals.descript: Paired devices can watch this computer's terminals, read-only: what they show, as it happens. Terminals often show passwords and keys, so this is off unless you turn it on. An agent hidden from paired devices keeps its shell hidden too.
settings.devices.publishPresence.label: Publish this computer to my devices
settings.devices.publishPresence.descrip: While you are signed in, your devices can list this computer from anywhere. Turn it off to stop; your devices then show it as offline. Dev builds don't publish.
settings.devices.shareSummaries.label: Share what my agents are working on
settings.devices.shareSummaries.descript: Other AgentMux windows on this computer and on your local network show each agent's one-line summary in their Swarm, next to its status. Anyone on your network who can reach AgentMux can read them. Turn it off to share status only.
settings.devices.statusbarMuxbusCloud.la: Show MuxBus Cloud in the status bar
settings.devices.statusbarMuxbusCloud.de: The cloud dot next to the host name, and the sign-in block in the host menu. Turn it off if you don't use MuxBus Cloud; LAN is not affected. You can still sign in from Accounts, and a dead cloud sign-in is no longer flagged in the status bar.
settings.agents.outdatedIds.label: Outdated agent ids
settings.agents.outdatedIds.description: Forks made by older builds got an id that repeats every generation (loap-loap-2-loap-3). Updating gives each the id it would get today (loap-3). The old id still receives messages and review notices for 30 days, and is never given to another agent.
settings.devices.hiddenAgents.label: Hidden from devices
settings.devices.hiddenAgents.descriptio: Agents kept off paired devices: they are left out of a device's list and can't be watched from one. Add an agent to hide it, or remove it to show it again.
settings.keyboard.shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.keyboard.shortcuts.description: See every shortcut and change or remove the ones you want. Help shows your own keys.
settings.keyboard.resetAll.label: Reset all shortcuts
settings.keyboard.resetAll.description: Put every shortcut back to the key AgentMux ships with.
settings.devices.muxbus.label: MuxBus
settings.devices.muxbus.description: MuxBus carries messages to this computer's agents from your other computers and from GitHub reviews and CI.
settings.notifications.showTray.label: Show icon in the system tray
settings.notifications.showTray.descript: Show an AgentMux icon in the system tray (the menu bar on macOS) while AgentMux is running. Always shown while “Keep running after all windows are closed” is on. Applies at the next launch. On Windows 11 new tray icons start in the overflow (^) area — drag it onto the taskbar to keep it visible.
settings.notifications.runInBackground.l: Keep running after all windows are closed
settings.notifications.runInBackground.d: When all windows are closed, AgentMux keeps running in the system tray instead of quitting. Quit it from the tray icon's menu. Applies at the next launch.
settings.notifications.autostart.label: Start at login
settings.notifications.autostart.descrip: Start AgentMux in the tray when you log in, without opening a window. The tray icon's menu has the same switch.
settings.notifications.osEnabled.label: Desktop notifications
settings.notifications.osEnabled.descrip: Show a system notification when an agent needs you or finishes while you're not looking at it.
settings.notifications.osWhen.label: When to notify
settings.notifications.osWhen.descriptio: “When AgentMux isn't focused” still alerts you if an agent needs input in a pane you aren't looking at.
settings.notifications.osInputWaiting.de: An agent asked a question and is waiting for your answer
settings.notifications.osTurnCompletedEx: Also for turns you didn't start
A turn another agent's message, a service notice, a scheduled run or a finished background task started. Off: it ends quietly unless it needs you
settings.notifications.osTurnErrored.des: An agent's turn ended with an error
settings.notifications.osAgentCrashed.de: Sign-in expired, usage limit, crash — not when you stop it yourself
settings.notifications.osNeedsReview.des: An agent received a message it must not act on without you. The notification never shows the message.
Once, when agents stop getting messages from other computers and GitHub until you sign in
settings.notifications.osAccountUnavaila: Agents out of quota or signed out
Once per account, when its agents hit a weekly limit or need you to sign in again (not for a session limit)
settings.notifications.osJobFailed.label: A job failed
settings.notifications.osJobFailed.descr: Once when a scheduled job starts failing, not for every failed run; the job's Kanban task collects the rest
settings.notifications.osVaultExpiring.d: 14 days before an entry's expiry date, 3 days before and on the day, once each
settings.notifications.pauseAllowAttenti: While paused, still alert when an agent needs me
Pause from the tray icon's menu. Input requests and review requests still get through.
Show a dot on AgentMux's taskbar button, and flash it once, while an agent needs you (Windows)
settings.notifications.quietHours.label: Quiet hours
settings.notifications.quietHours.descri: Hold notifications back every day during these hours (local time), e.g. 22:00-08:00. Leave empty for none.
settings.notifications.osSummary.label: Show what the agent is working on
settings.notifications.osSummary.descrip: Add the agent's current session summary as a small line under the notification
settings.notifications.osPreview.label: Notification content
settings.notifications.osPreview.descrip: How much of an agent's question to show. Credentials and sensitive terms are always hidden.
settings.notifications.osTest.label: Send test notification
settings.notifications.osTest.descriptio: Check that notifications reach your desktop (Windows Focus / Do Not Disturb may hold it in the notification center).
settings.devices.pinnedSenders.label: Pinned senders
settings.devices.pinnedSenders.descripti: The first key AgentMux sees for an agent's name on your network, and the first of your installs it sees speaking for that name through your cloud account, are remembered, and a message from anything else is refused as unverified. If an agent really did change (it was recreated, or moved to another computer), accept the new one here. Forget a pin to trust whatever speaks for that name next.
settings.recording.enableVoiceInput.desc: Show the microphone button on agent and terminal panes
settings.recording.engine.label: Engine
settings.recording.engine.description: whisper.cpp runs fully offline; Groq sends audio to Groq's API
settings.recording.groqApiKey.label: Groq API key
settings.recording.groqApiKey.descriptio: Sent once, over HTTPS, from the AgentMux backend on this machine directly to api.groq.com — never to any other AgentMux service.
settings.recording.whisperCliPath.label: whisper-cli path
settings.recording.model.label: Model
settings.recording.model.description: Auto-downloaded on first use. Only one of Model or Model file path applies at a time — file path takes precedence if both are set.
settings.recording.modelFilePath.label: Model file path
settings.recording.inputDevice.label: Input device
settings.sounds.volume.label: Volume
settings.sounds.suppressWhenFocused.desc: Don't play a pane's sound when it's already focused and visible
settings.sounds.turnComplete.label: Turn complete
settings.sounds.turnComplete.description: Play a sound when an agent turn completes normally
settings.sounds.turnError.label: Turn error
settings.sounds.turnError.description: Play a sound when an agent turn ends with an error
settings.sounds.turnInterrupted.label: Turn interrupted
settings.sounds.turnInterrupted.descript: Play a sound when an agent turn is stopped or interrupted
settings.sounds.messageAccepted.label: Message accepted
settings.sounds.messageAccepted.descript: Play a sound when a queued pending message is accepted
settings.sounds.messageRejected.label: Message rejected
settings.sounds.messageRejected.descript: Play a sound when a queued pending message is rejected
settings.sounds.toolTonesEnabled.label: Enable
settings.sounds.toolTonesEnabled.descrip: Play a subliminal synth tone for every agent tool call
settings.sounds.toolTonesVolume.label: Volume
settings.sounds.toolTonesScope.label: Scope
settings.sounds.toolTonesFlash.label: Flash the tab and pane when a sound plays
settings.sounds.toolTonesFlash.descripti: Pulse the pane tab each sound came from, in that pane's color, and subtly its window tab — one pulse per knock, in time with the sound
settings.sounds.waitingToneEnabled.label: Enable
settings.sounds.waitingToneEnabled.descr: Play a looping tone while an agent waits for you: a question, a tool permission, a browser hand-off or approval, an SSH consent or a widget install
settings.sounds.waitingBrowser.label: Browser hand-offs and approvals
settings.sounds.waitingBrowser.descripti: Also when an agent hands you a browser pane or asks to approve something in it
settings.sounds.waitingToast.label: Toast when an agent waits
settings.sounds.waitingToast.description: Show a toast that names the agent waiting on you, with a link that takes you to it. Stays on when sounds are muted
settings.sounds.shutdownToneEnabled.desc: Play a falling chime when something other than you asks to shut an agent down, at the start of the window to keep it and again with 5 seconds left
settings.sounds.waitingToneVolume.label: Volume
settings.agents.startAgents.label: Agents may start agents
settings.agents.startAgents.description: Off by default. The first time an agent starts another agent, its pane shows a card with a 30 second countdown that goes ahead on its own: Stop it, Start now, or Always allow that agent. Turn this on to skip the card for every agent; its pane still shows a one-line notice.
settings.supervisor.supervisor.label: Swarm Supervisor
settings.supervisor.supervisor.descripti: Opens the Swarm's Supervisor settings: the switch, limits, wait before continuing, fleet budget and notices
settings.widgetBar.bar.label: Widget bar
settings.widgetBar.bar.description: Choose what the widget bar shows. Pinned widgets are icons on the bar, More keeps them in the More menu, and Hidden removes them from both and from a pane's + menu.
settings.widgetBar.iconOnly.label: Show icons only
settings.widgetBar.iconOnly.description: Icons without text labels on the widget bar
settings.widgetBar.reset.label: Reset widget bar
settings.widgetBar.reset.description: Back to the default pinned widgets, with nothing hidden
settings.widgets.installed.label: Widgets
settings.widgets.installed.description: Widgets add your own kinds of pane. A widget runs only after you approve it here, and asks again whenever its files change.
